descriptionChirho: Hanani (חֲנָנִי) — a proper name borne by several individuals: (a) a seer who rebuked King Asa of Judah (2 Chr 16:7-10), (b) a priestly musician in David's time (1 Chr 25:4,25), (c) a priest who had taken a foreign wife (Ezra 10:20), (d) Nehemiah's brother who brought news of Jerusalem's distress (Neh 1:2; 7:2), and (e) another priestly musician at the wall dedication (Neh 12:36). English 'Hanani/Chanani/for Chanani,' Spanish 'Jananí/Hananí/para Hanani,' Hindi हनानी/हनानी के लिए, Arabic حناني/لحناني, Korean 하나니/에게 하난니, Swahili Hanani/kwa Hanani. The two clusters differ only by the preposition ל prefix.
